Chapter 6927: Considerate

Chapter 6927: Considerate

“Regardless, have to kill Perpetual first.” Li Qiye said, frightening the listeners.

“Perpetual Immortal is a dao galaxy that flows with no pattern in space.” Timeflow said.

“Then I’ll flip Ancient over to find him.” Li Qiye said.

“...” Timeflow became speechless but more importantly, one-third of Ancient belonged to his grandmaster.

“Immortal, no need for that. I, I know where he is.” He said.

“Oh?” Li Qiye stared at him.

The stare nearly made his heart jump out of his body. He became drenched in sweat as he gulped nervously: “I know the three Perpetual Sword Gods know his whereabouts.”

“Then why are we still here?” Li Qiye said.

“Yes, yes.” Timeflow immediately agreed. Before leaving, he bowed toward Cerulean and said: “Brother, apologies.”

Cerulean didn’t dare to act tough at this point and said: “It’s okay, it’s okay, not a big deal at all.”

He was happy just to stay alive. Moreover, Timeflow did beg on his behalf and saved him.

Once the two left, he returned to his body and left right away, not daring to linger in this world. The experience traumatized him so he chose to live reclusively henceforth.

***

Within a firmament of Ancient, a pine grew in space. Time only made it stronger, not weaker. Beneath were three gods with an absolute sword domain able to kill any intruder.

Cultivators in this firmament considered the domain to be holy. The sword dao emanated from these three sword gods known as Perpetual.

They were part of Breaker Immortal’s branch and direct disciples of Perpetual Immortal. As overlords, they ruled over this firmament.

The inhabitants only knew of them, not of the immortals above. They worshipped them as the originators of the sword dao. Emperors and ancient ancestors weren’t qualified to set foot in their domain.

“Who is it?” The first visitor after many eras alarmed them, forcing them to open their eyes.

Sword energy erupted, ready to kill anyone.

“Dao Brothers, excuse us.” Timeflow entered with Li Qiye.

The trio only focused on Timeflow, not Li Qiye. Timeflow was an overlord just like them.

“Fellow Daoist, may I ask why you are here?” They asked while still seated, showing no interest in hospitality.

They were stronger and more renowned than this overlord. After all, overlords did vary in strength.

“Dao Brothers, I am here to ask about Perpetual Immortal’s whereabouts.” He bowed and said with a smile.

The trio frowned upon hearing this and exchanged glances.

“Do you wish to know or is it for a senior in your branch?” One of them asked.

He introduced Li Qiye: “The great immortal wishes to know, please oblige.”

Their expression darkened upon hearing this. Sun, one of the three, uttered coldly: “Fellow Daoist, this isn’t funny. We will let it go out of consideration for your branch.”

“This is no joke, please cooperate lest you make a grave mistake.” He repeated but didn’t care too much about the trio’s survival.

“A mistake?” Their auras erupted.

“Speak and I will spare your lives.” Li Qiye said.

“Is that so?” They thought this was hilarious.

“Hahaha, we brothers haven’t heard something like this in a long time. Timeflow, who is he? I will teach him a lesson in your stead.” Moon said.

“I said what I should, don’t blame me if you court death, Dao Brothers.” Timeflow said.

“We were considerate, yet you wish to be humiliated?” The trio stood up.

“Immortal, they definitely know the location.” He shamelessly hid behind Li Qiye, seemingly eager to see Li Qiye read their mind.

“Last chance.” Li Qiye said.

“Hahaha, ignorant brat, I’ll kill you first.” They laughed and decided to kill him. In their eyes, a mortal was inferior to an insect.
